findings.message: The declaration does not fit claimed template T2, so its data are not checked. WP1 refusals: [T2.replicated] With one 'run' per treatment level there is no variation among units treated alike, so the treatment test has zero error degrees of freedom (brief Section 5.2). explanation.text: The declaration does not describe a design Stratum supports, so the data are not checked or analyzed for this decision. This is a judgment about the declared design, not a crash or a data error. The specific reasons are listed underneath, each with what would have to change. (When the only reason is a single unit per treatment level, the data are still read to plan a better design; that planning cannot change the decision.)

wp1_refusals.requirement: replicates_per_level >= 2 experimental units per treatment level
wp1_refusals.reason: With one 'run' per treatment level there is no variation among units treated alike, so the treatment test has zero error degrees of freedom (brief Section 5.2). Subsamples measure within-unit variation only; more of them cannot replace replicated 'run' units.
wp1_refusals.remedy: Run at least two 'run' units per treatment level. No declaration change can make this design testable.

explanation.text: The declaration has too few units at some level for the claimed template, most often a single run (or other experimental unit) per treatment level. With one unit per level there is no way to see how much units treated alike differ from each other, so there is nothing to judge a treatment difference against. Measuring more wafers or sites inside that unit does not help, because they all share it. More independent units per treatment level are needed.
